findings.claim: Officer Lee first observed the blue sedan at about 21:14 near mile marker 4, travelling 58 mph in a posted 45 zone.
The driver pulled into the Harbor Gas lot and stopped around 21:16.
findings.quote:
00:00:06.000 --> 00:00:12.000
[SYNTHETIC] Officer Lee: Pulling in at the lot, about 21:16.

findings.claim: A 911 call reporting the incident was logged at 21:11.
Dispatch records show a unit on scene roughly 2 minutes after the stop.
Officer Lee states the vehicle was the only car in the lane.
